svg.title: Ongoing / Ongoing as a software inventory
svg.desc: The whole redesign in one frame, and it has all landed: entries, the field registry, the query grammar, the entries API, the CLI and its transport, the keyboard-first browser shell that builds the same query string, the provider manifests, one configuration file, the host adapter, the deployment and export profiles, and Phase 6 — completeness from the registry, repositories with no local checkout, and an install that is two commands.. Architecture structure.
